bound_semantics.alias_rule: Within GP12_REBUILD_CANDIDATE_V1 only, sector_adjusted_close is an input-family label bound to the canonical SW industry index close level. It does not mean applying stock adj_factor/qfq mechanics to an index.
bound_semantics.continuity_rule: Accept the provider's published index level for that same trade date; do not synthesize, forward-fill, or splice across dates without row-level provider provenance.

evidence.observation: INDUSTRY_KEEP carries industry_code, trade_date, OHLC, vol and amount; both sw_daily and index_hist_sw materialize close directly and no adj_factor is applied to industry index rows.
Course feature paths compute industry returns from industry_close / shifted industry_close, providing corroborating candidate semantics for using an industry index close level as the return basis.
SW/index interfaces describe close as the index closing point/level rather than an equity unadjusted close requiring a stock qfq factor.

exclusions: Does not prove historical GP V1.1 used the same sector series.
